1912
FATHER SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 12
Page 10 Cont.
Feb. 2nd
Feast of Purification, Candlemass, nice little pro-
cession in Church. Being 1st Friday also there was
good attendence at the Holy Sacram's nearly 600 Com-
munions.
Feb. 13 Rev. Pater Casimir, O.M. Cap. died well prepared after a sickness of three months of dropey, heart trouble, etc.
Feb. 15th He was Solemnly laid to rest in Monastery cemetery in Yonkers the following Thursday Feb. 15. Deceased was 56 yrs. old - 39 yrs in the Order and 31 years a priest. R.I. Pace. Read Lectum. "I am" Feb. 17 Edw'd Bly. became an Altar-boy received 1st appointment at following Feb. 24th.
March came in more like a lion than a lamb. First days, eve- ning service Wm Hayes "spilt" coals of burning censer. little harm done.
Page 11
March 4th Mrs. Augusta Feeney (nonCatholic) desiring to receive "Jesus in the Blessed Sacrament" to whom, in a special maner she had been praying for 30 days - "Jesus In The Blessed Sacrament have Mercy On Us!" became a Catholic received Every thing, surprised every one by reviving, after receiving the holy sacraments and living three days longer.
March 6 Mrs. Feeney at 11 P.M. peacefully born into eternity with Jesus in her heart and on her breast and His holy name whispered in her ears.
March 9 Funeral M.C. at 11 A.M. for same Augusta Feeney. After Mass Fr. Solan. made a few charitable remarks and ex- horted all to imitate "Our poor little deceased sister's example - not necesarily in becoming Catholics "- but in God's Name I do exhort you to implore The Most High to give you a will in conformithy with His will, a will to love and embrace His will at all times and at every cost .--- Then no doubt we shall have the happiness of know ing the truth of loving and embracing the truth and the truth will make you free.
